Title: Bindlewick Circulation API documentation

# Bindlewick Circulation API

The Circulation API lets libraries running Bindlewick lend, renew and reserve items from
their own systems: self-service kiosks, discovery layers and reading apps. The current
version is 2. Version 1 is deprecated and stops answering on 31 October 2026.

## Start here

- What changed in each release: https://docs.bindlewick.example/changelog
- Errors: https://docs.bindlewick.example/v2/errors
- SDKs and tools: https://docs.bindlewick.example/sdks

## Reference (v2)

- Loans: https://docs.bindlewick.example/v2/reference/loans
- Holds: https://docs.bindlewick.example/v2/reference/holds

## Reference (v1, deprecated)

- Checkouts: https://docs.bindlewick.example/v1/reference/checkouts

The API's base URL is `https://api.bindlewick.example`. Keys are issued by your library's
Bindlewick administrator.
